title: Signal Sandbox Lifecycle Demo

launch.notes: Bootstraps the existing signal-plugin-sandbox broker binary, records a machine-readable receipt, and emits a rendered operator companion.

scenarios.title: Sandbox Lifecycle Bootstrap
scenarios.summary: Exercises ready, explicit attach/status/teardown, healthy run, timeout run, and broker shutdown through the existing sandbox broker binary.

evidence.notes: This bootstrap surface proves the sandbox broker lifecycle while adding a rendered operator companion and without widening into plugin capability browsing or host/runtime demo coverage.

known_exclusions: Plugin capability browsing remains deferred to later g09.012 batches.
Host, runtime, and hardware demo surfaces remain deferred.
Format-specific AU, VST3, and LV2 live demo coverage is not claimed by this bootstrap manifest.
expected_checks: The broker reports ready before lifecycle commands run.
The explicit attach/status/teardown path is inspectable.
The healthy demo run reaches running and teardown_complete states.
The timeout demo run reports timed_out and cleanup-after-timeout states.
The rendered companion view makes broker lifecycle and timeout recovery posture visually inspectable without reading the raw receipt first.
The final receipt records a clean shutdown.
